decisions.reason: The Units remark falsely identifies the bounded spin operator S_i with hbar times the total generator J_i=L_i+S_i. Replaced it by the typed identities S_i=M_(S_i^fin), J_i=L_i+S_i and the dimensionless matrices S_i^fin/hbar; no Statement, proof or prerequisite was changed.
